news.headline: North Dakota Tourism & Arrivalist Featured at Destinations International
Enhancing Your Arrivalist Experience: A Stronger Foundation for Geolocation Insights

paragraphs: Arrivalist sells visitor and spending analytics to the people who market travel destinations. The pitch is measurement of actual destination visits and spending. It also sells advertising measurement, showing which campaigns increased visits and spend.

The data pinpoints where visitors come from, down to DMA, city or zip code. It measures how long they stay and how many stay overnight. It follows where they go next, including points of interest and merchants. Any season or event can be compared year over year, down to the day. Activity is reported at day level for visitors and residents alike. The spending side draws on anonymized card-spend patterns.

The company describes its customers as tourism offices that report to state and local stakeholders. It says its modeling can quantify economic impact. Prospects are invited to book a short call and see visitor and spend data for their own destination.
